description: Define F(n,x) as the power series in x satisfying F(n,x) = 1 + x*F(n,x)^2 - x^n*F(n,x)^(2*n), then for n >= 2, a(n) = abs( [x^M] F(n,x) ) where x^M is the first power of x with a negative coefficient in F(n,x). Should no such M exist for some n, then there are no further terms and this sequence would be finite.
